Subject JOSEF SCHWARTZ - ACTIVITIES OF.
Made by D.S.I. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Josef SCHWARTZ, a former Austrian Citizen,navigator
by profession,was born on May 25th.1893 in Trieste.
During the Great War,Schwartz fought against Russia
in the ranks of the Austrian Army and was subsequently
captured by the Russian Troops and kept in Russia as
a prisoner of war.
Following the conclusion of peace,the city of
Trieste was ceded to Italy by Austria and Schwartz
automatically became an Italian Subject.
In 1919 Schwartz,whilst he was in Vladivostock,
Russia,joined the French Military Mission there as an
interpreter and was later given the rank of Corporal
in the French Army. He remained with the French
Military Mission in Vladivostock until the end of 1920
when he left for Shanghai. In January of 1921,Schwartz
joined the French Police and was attached to the
Traffic Department. In September 1922,he resigned the
French Police as a result of his losing his service
pistol which,as it was alleged,he had sold.
Since then he subsisted by obtaining casual
work and was for a number of years a secret informer
of the French Police.

报告
事由：约瑟夫·施瓦茨（JOSEF SCHWARTZ）之活动。
呈报人：副督察马卡耶夫斯基（Maklaevsky）。转呈人：督察克劳福德（Crawford）。

约瑟夫·施瓦茨，前奥地利公民，职业为领航员，1893年5月25日出生于的里雅斯特（Trieste）。
大战期间，施瓦茨在奥匈帝国军队中服役并对抗俄国，随后被俄军俘虏并作为战俘拘禁于俄国。
和平条约签订后，的里雅斯特市由奥地利割让给意大利，施瓦茨自动成为意大利臣民。
1919年，施瓦茨身处俄国符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock），以翻译身份加入当地的法国军事代表团，后在法军中获下士军衔。他留在符拉迪沃斯托克的法国军事代表团直至1920年底，随后前往上海。1921年1月，施瓦茨加入法租界巡捕房，隶属于交通科。1922年9月，他因丢失配枪而辞去法租界巡捕房职务，据称他将该枪出售。
此后，他靠打零工维持生计，并在数年间担任法租界巡捕房的秘密线人。
1930年，他获得宫殿酒店（Palace Hotel）酒吧经理一职，任职至1934年辞职。

他目前受雇于双麦啤酒厂（Two Brewery）担任推销员。
他会说德语、意大利语、英语、俄语、西班牙语和法语。
1935年8月16日，施瓦茨因涉嫌卷入一起毒品走私案而被法租界巡捕房逮捕，但未对他提出指控，并于当日释放。
当意大利建立法西斯政权时，施瓦茨因其社会主义倾向，放弃了意大利国籍，恢复其真实国籍——奥地利籍。
在奥地利被并入德意志帝国一段时间后，施瓦茨获得了德国护照，并成为了一名非常狂热的亲德分子。
然而，尚不清楚施瓦茨是否与盖世太保或任何其他德国政治组织有关联。

Shanghai Municipal Police.

CENTRAL Station.
January 26 1923

REPORT ON Charles Swaral
15 u 27

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

The French Police say there has never been anyone bearing the name Charles Swaral in their Force.

A man named Joseph Schwartz, a Hungarian, now registered at the Italian Consulate, who is said to have been attached to the Allied forces in Siberia, joined the French Police locally about eighteen months ago. He was attached to the traffic staff but he was recently asked to resign as he was an associate of well known opium smugglers and was suspected of being concerned in the traffic in drugs and generally untrustworthy. After leaving the French Police he was employed at the Fei Lung Garage and was seen at the Mixed Court when the case against the proprietor of the garage was heard recently. Schwartz speaks English, French, Italian, German, and Russian. He may be the man referred to under another name.

The Compagnie Franco-Siberienne, 12 Nanking Road, has been established about two years. A French citizen named Challiet who is an engineer by profession, and a Russian lawyer named Fishman who is on the Mixed Court roll of lawyers, were with the firm when it was first established but there is reason to believe they have both left now. The firm still rent one room at 12 Nanking Road but it is nearly always locked and apparently no business is done. Several visits have been made to the premises but neither Chinese nor foreigners can so far be found there.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名：J. Sullivan.）
D. C. I.

中央分局。
1923年1月26日

关于查尔斯·斯瓦拉尔（Charles Swaral）的报告
15 u 27

呈报人：沙利文（Sullivan）副督察。转呈人：刑事情报处处长。

先生，

法租界巡捕房表示，其警队中从未有过名为查尔斯·斯瓦拉尔的人。

有一名名为约瑟夫·施瓦茨（Joseph Schwartz）的匈牙利人，目前在意大利领事馆注册，据称曾隶属于西伯利亚的协约国部队，约十八个月前加入本地的法租界巡捕房。他隶属于交通科，但最近被要求辞职，因为他是知名鸦片走私贩的同伙，涉嫌参与毒品交易，且总体上不可信任。离开法租界巡捕房后，他在飞龙汽车行（Fei Lung Garage）受雇，并在最近审理该车行业主案件时，被人看到出现在混合法庭。施瓦茨会说英语、法语、意大利语、德语和俄语。他可能就是以另一个名字被提及的那个人。

法西伯利亚公司（Compagnie Franco-Siberienne），位于南京路12号，成立约两年。该公司初创时，有一位名为查利埃（Challiet）的法国公民（职业为工程师）和一位名为费什曼（Fishman）的俄国律师（名列混合法庭律师名册）与之共事，但有理由相信他们两人现已离开。该公司仍在南京路12号租用一间房间，但该房间几乎总是锁着，显然没有开展任何业务。已多次前往该处所查看，但至今未在那里发现任何中国人或外国人。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名：J. Sullivan。）
刑事情报处副处长（D. C. I.）

（左侧边缘手写批注：收悉 / m / 2）
